# Crashes per day
```{r this_this_is_the_name_of_the_chunk}

crashes_per_day = 30125 / 365
crashes_per_day


```


# looking at what symbols do

```{r}

# = Stores the value under a name

Crash_per_day = 30125/365


# typing the name shows the value
Crashes_per_day


# -> does the same thing as the = sign
Crashes_per_day <- 30125 / 365

```



# Running a factor

```{r}
crashes_by_day = c(200, 250, 230, 40, 57, 6, 7)

names(crashes_by_day)= c ("Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thur", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")

crashes_by_day

```



# Making an integer

```{r}

crashes_by_date = c(200L, 250L, 230L, 40L, 57L, 6L, 7L)

names(crashes_by_date)= c ("Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thur", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")

crashes_by_date

typeof(crashes_by_date)

```
